name: 泉州
description: Quanzhou is a historic port city in Fujian, known as the starting point of the Maritime Silk Road. Home to diverse religious sites including Buddhism, Islam, Christianity, and Hinduism. Called 'Zayton' by Marco Polo. A UNESCO World Heritage city with incredible cultural diversity.
highlights: Kaiyuan Temple - Largest Song Dynasty temple in Fujian
Qingjing Mosque - Oldest mosque in China
Sri Lankan Buddhist Temple - Unique foreign architecture
Maritime Silk Road Museum - Ancient trade history

climate.tips: Best in spring and autumn. Summers hot and humid. Winter mild. Year-round destination due to cultural sites.

attractions.name: 開元寺
attractions.description: 福建最大的宋代佛教寺廟，以著名的雙塔聞名。
attractions.tips: 提早抵達。雙塔是標誌性建築。

attractions.name: 清淨寺
attractions.description: 中國最古老的清真寺，建於1009年，具有阿拉伯建築風格。
attractions.tips: 衣著端莊。重要的伊斯蘭文化遺產。

attractions.name: 泉州木偶戲
attractions.description: 傳統福建布袋戲，結合古老木偶藝術。
attractions.tips: 請提前購票。必看的文化體驗。

attractions.name: 清源山
attractions.description: 神聖的山，擁有佛教寺廟、古代雕塑和茶館。
attractions.tips: 日出時分前往可欣賞美景。試試山茶。

attractions.name: 天后宮
attractions.description: 最重要的媽祖廟，海上女神，備受船員崇敬。
attractions.tips: 海洋文化重要。可順道品嚐附近的媽祖餅。

attractions.name: 洛陽橋
attractions.description: 宋代古石橋，中國四大名橋之一。
attractions.tips: 夕陽時分最美。古代工程奇蹟。

attractions.name: 府文廟
attractions.description: 福建最大的孔廟，建築優美。
attractions.tips: 可搭配鄰近的開元寺一同參觀。

attractions.name: 海外交通史博物館
attractions.description: 展示泉州古代海上貿易歷史的博物館。
attractions.tips: 非常適合了解泉州的重要性。

attractions.name: 南少林寺
attractions.description: 著名的武術寺廟，中國拳術的發源地。
attractions.tips: 觀賞武術表演。非常適合功夫迷。

attractions.name: 石獅黃金海岸
attractions.description: 美麗的海灘區域，擁有海岸風光和度假設施。
attractions.tips: 最適合海灘時光。從泉州出發的一日遊。

attractions.name: 閩臺緣博物館
attractions.description: 展示福建與臺灣文化聯繫的博物館。
attractions.tips: 對於了解區域聯繫非常重要。

attractions.name: 塗門街
attractions.description: 歷史悠久的街道，擁有來自多種信仰的多元宗教建築。
attractions.tips: 步行即可在同一條街上看到清真寺、寺廟和教堂。

attractions.name: 崇武古城
attractions.description: 明代沿海堡壘，擁有石雕工藝和海灘。
attractions.tips: 一日遊。以石雕傳統聞名。

attractions.name: 牛姆林
attractions.description: 自然保護區，擁有古樹、徒步小徑和清新空氣。
attractions.tips: 一日遊。非常適合自然愛好者。

attractions.name: 仙公山
attractions.description: 聖山，擁有寺廟、壯麗景色和民俗廟會。
attractions.tips: 乘坐纜車。深受當地人喜愛，用於祈福。

attractions.name: 泉州博物館
attractions.description: 地區博物館，收藏有關泉州歷史和文化的展品。
attractions.tips: 結合附近的文藝景點一起遊覽。

attractions.name: 蟳埔漁村
attractions.description: 傳統漁村，擁有獨特的蝸牛殼屋和頭戴花飾的當地婦女。
attractions.tips: 清晨參觀，可以看到漁民帶著漁獲回來。

attractions.name: 鄭和航海遺蹟
attractions.description: 與鄭和航海相關的歷史遺址，包括他的廟宇和航海紀念碑。
attractions.tips: 了解中國的海洋探索歷史。

attractions.name: 永寧古衛城
attractions.description: 明代海防堡壘，福建省三大堡壘之一。
attractions.tips: 遊客較少，保留著真實的古代氛圍。

attractions.name: 黃金漁排
attractions.description: 獨特的海上漂浮漁場體驗，提供新鮮海鮮餐飲。
attractions.tips: 日落時分最佳。可以品嚐剛從海中捕撈的新鮮海鮮。

attractions.name: 閩南建築博物館
attractions.description: 博物館展示傳統閩南建築風格，包括土樓類型的建築。
attractions.tips: 非常適合了解閩南建築技術。

attractions.name: 泉州創意產業園
attractions.description: 由舊工廠改建而成的藝術和創意中心，設有畫廊、咖啡館和工作坊。
attractions.tips: 非常適合現代藝術和紀念品。

attractions.name: 惠安女民俗村
attractions.description: 體驗惠安女獨特的服飾文化和漁業傳統。
attractions.tips: 觀看女性編織並了解她們的獨特習俗。

attractions.name: 九仙山
attractions.description: 神聖的道教名山，以獨特的巖石地貌、雲海和高山草甸而聞名。
attractions.tips: 雨後參觀最佳，可欣賞雲海。

attractions.description: 博物館專門介紹德化瓷器，又稱「白瓷」，擁有千年歷史。
attractions.tips: 購買正宗的德化瓷器作為紀念品。

culturalTips.title: Maritime Silk Road
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou was major port on Maritime Silk Road, visited by Marco Polo who called it Zayton. Diverse foreign religions settled here including Islam, Christianity, Hinduism.

culturalTips.title: Religious Diversity
culturalTips.content: 泉州擁有獨特的宗教多樣性——佛教寺廟、伊斯蘭教清真寺、基督教教堂和印度教遺址在塗門街上並存。

culturalTips.title: Minnan Cuisine
culturalTips.content: 泉州是閩南菜系的中心，以海鮮、薑母鴨、粽子以及獨特的土筍凍等小吃而聞名。

culturalTips.title: Stone Carving
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou and nearby Hui'an are famous for stone carving tradition, visible at Chongwu Ancient City.

culturalTips.title: Southern Shaolin
culturalTips.content: Southern Shaolin Temple at Qingyuan Mountain is birthplace of many Chinese martial arts styles including Hung Gar boxing.

culturalTips.title: Overseas Chinese Heritage
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou is major overseas Chinese hometown. Many Chinese diaspora from Southeast Asia trace ancestry here. The華僑文化 is strong.

culturalTips.title: Minnan Architectural Style
culturalTips.content: Minnan houses feature red brick, white walls, and ornate roof ridges with upturned corners. The閩南建築風格 is distinct from other Chinese regional styles.

culturalTips.title: Mazu Worship
culturalTips.content: 泉州是媽祖信仰的重要中心，媽祖是海神。天后宮是世界上最重要的媽祖廟之一。

culturalTips.title: 茶文化
culturalTips.content: 福建以茶聞名，泉州也有其獨特的茶文化傳統。前往清源山的茶館，體驗山間茶文化。

culturalTips.title: Nanyin Music
culturalTips.content: Nanyin (南音) is ancient music from Quanzhou, recognized as intangible cultural heritage. Listen to performances at Quanzhou Puppet Show.

culturalTips.title: Minnan Dialect
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou speakers use Minnanhua (閩南話), a distinct dialect group. It's mutually intelligible with Taiwanese and Southeast Asian Chinese communities.

culturalTips.title: 惠安女 Culture
culturalTips.content: Hui'an women are famous for their colorful costumes, including直達髻 headpieces and short上衣. They traditionally handle fishing while men work abroad.

culturalTips.title: 海鮮文化
culturalTips.content: Being a coastal city, seafood is central to Quanzhou cuisine. Fresh fish, crab, shrimp, and shellfish appear in most dishes.

culturalTips.title: Zheng He Connections
culturalTips.content: Zheng He, the famous Ming Dynasty admiral, was associated with Quanzhou. His maritime legacy is celebrated at several historical sites.

culturalTips.title: Buddhist Heritage
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou has been Buddhist center for over 1000 years. Kaiyuan Temple and Qingyuan Mountain are important Buddhist sites.

culturalTips.title: Dehua Porcelain
culturalTips.content: Dehua County near Quanzhou produces world-famous white porcelain, called 'white gold' in ancient times. Visit museums and factories.

culturalTips.title: Street Food Culture
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou has vibrant night markets and street food culture. Try local snacks at路邊攤 and傳統小販 for authentic flavors.

culturalTips.title: Traditional Festivals
culturalTips.content: Quanzhou celebrates traditional festivals with unique customs including Mazu birthday, 中秋博餅, and various temple fairs.
